source: DHM Islamic Studies Level 2 · lesson 29. Exercises reused from the lesson.
topic: The fifth pillar: visiting the Ka'bah

learn.en: Hajj is the last of the five pillars. Like salah, zakah and sawm, it shapes our lives to submit fully to Allah.
learn.title: The fifth pillar

learn.en: Hajj means to set out to visit the Ka'bah, the House of Allah in Makkah.
learn.title: To the Ka'bah

learn.en: Hajj goes back to the life of Prophet Ibraheem — a wonderful story you will learn about in the coming years, insha'Allah!
learn.title: Ibraheem's story

learn.en: “And due to Allah from the people is a pilgrimage to the House — for whoever is able to find thereto a way.” (Qur'an 3:97)
learn.title: From the Qur'an

quiz.en: Hajj means to visit the ___ in Makkah.
Hajj goes back to the life of Prophet…
True or false? Every Muslim who is able should do hajj once in life.

think.q: If you could go to Makkah one day, what would you most like to see?
think.a: The Ka'bah, the Black Stone, Zamzam… make du'aa to go one day!

parents.summary: Hajj, the fifth pillar: visiting the Ka'bah, House of Allah, once in life for those able; rooted in Prophet Ibraheem's story.

try.en: Here I am, O Allah, here I am

parents.tip: Watch a short clip of the Ka'bah together and talk about it.
